name: Texas Eastern Lebanon Lateral
monitor_reason: length and existence not confirmed; one 1998 trade-press hit whose text could not be read here to confirm 114 mi; no second source; possible overlap with Texas Eastern Main Line P0262
researcher_notes: The only evidence is a 1998 Natural Gas Intelligence item. The page loads, but its text was not retrievable here, so the 114 mile length, the Gas City Indiana to Lebanon Ohio endpoints and the 300 MMcf/d compression expansion could not be read directly. No second independent source was found. The line is already operating and no new pipe is proposed, so there is no concrete step to add. The roster has no row for it, but it may be carried inside the Texas Eastern Main Line row P0262 (14,202 mi system figure). It is not Borealis P7794. To upgrade: find a FERC filing or Texas Eastern system map naming the Lebanon Lateral and its length, then decide whether it is a separate row or part of P0262.
